about_the_game:
Build your firefighting experience with the Year 1 Season Pass for Firefighting Simulator: Ignite! Save up to 36% compared to an individual purchase, thanks to fantastic additional content. The additional content is planned to launch in 2025 and 2026.

The Year 1 Season Pass includes:

1x Season Pass exclusive firefighting helmet

1x Expansion Pack

2x Mission DLCs

1x Mission Pack

1x Vehicle Pack

1x Vehicle Skin Pack

1x Cosmetic Pack
